report.summary: Proposed 4 work items: enforce trace_id in eval tasks (high), guard offload_runner exceptions (high), cross-module batch validation (medium), protect council_env dict (medium). Gates 0-1.
risks: Settling checks require manual inspection of code not fully indexed; assumptions may be wrong.
Fixing trace_id mismatch could require schema changes to eval tasks, which may have broader impact.
Adding exception handling to offload_runner may change error propagation that existing callers rely on.
todos: Inspect tasks.py for trace_id field and record_intent call sites.
Inspect offload_runner implementation for possible exceptions and current error handling.
Search for cross-module batch validation; if absent, design and implement.
Grep all callers of council_env to verify none mutate the result; if any do, fix or add copy.

items.title: Enforce trace_id consistency in eval task intents
items.why_now: Misattributed intents could corrupt the ledger, making attempts unrecoverable. This is a core data integrity issue.

steps.do: Inspect the TASKS list in daedalus/eval/tasks.py to confirm trace_id is absent; if absent, add trace_id field to task schema.
steps.verified_by: grep 'trace_id' daedalus/eval/tasks.py shows expected field or documentation updated.

steps.do: Inspect all call sites of record_intent in the codebase; ensure trace_id is explicitly passed where the context may differ.
steps.verified_by: grep -rn 'record_intent' daedalus/ shows explicit trace_id argument at each call; no call relies on default current_trace_id() when context differs.

items.assumption: The TASKS list is the canonical source for task shape; trace_id field can be added without breaking existing tasks.

items.title: Guard offload_runner against unhandled exceptions
items.why_now: If offload_runner can raise, callers lack exception handling, risking cascading failures in the critical attempt path.

steps.do: Locate offload_runner definition (grep 'def offload_runner') and inspect its implementation for possible exceptions (e.g., subprocess failures, I/O errors).
steps.verified_by: List of exception types that offload_runner may raise is documented.

steps.do: Add try/except in _recording_runner (daedalus/spine/picker.py) and _default_attempt (daedalus/spine/attempt.py) to handle exceptions from offload_runner, logging and returning a safe fallback.
steps.verified_by: Tests show that when offload_runner raises, the callers return a safe default without crashing.
Tests pass with injected offload_runner exception.

items.assumption: offload_runner is defined somewhere in the codebase; its exact location is unknown but its callers are identified.

items.title: Add cross-module batch size validation
items.why_now: Without validation, a large batch from one module can cause timeout or overflow in another, leading to silent failures or resource exhaustion.

steps.do: Search for any existing cross-module batch size validation (grep for 'batch' and 'limit' in daedalus/). If none found, document the assumption and add a shared validation function.
steps.verified_by: grep returns no existing cross-module batch validation; a new validation module is created and integrated.

steps.do: Add a validation function in daedalus/structcore/ or daedalus/spine/ that checks input size against all consumer limits before processing.
steps.verified_by: Unit test verifies that a batch exceeding any consumer limit is rejected with a clear error.

items.assumption: Batch-producing and batch-consuming modules are identifiable; their limits are documented or can be extracted.

items.title: Protect council_env returned dict from mutation
items.why_now: The docstring claims the dict is never mutated, but it is mutable; a caller could accidentally alter subprocess environments, causing subtle bugs.

steps.do: Grep all callers of council_env (grep -rn 'council_env' daedalus/) to verify none mutate the result.
steps.verified_by: Output shows no caller mutates the returned dict; if any does, fix the caller or add a copy.

steps.do: In daedalus/council/vendors.py, change council_env to return a copy of the dict (e.g., dict(env)) or wrap in a read-only proxy.
steps.verified_by: After change, callers that previously mutated (if any) now work correctly; no caller is broken.

items.assumption: The function council_env is defined in daedalus/council/vendors.py and returns a plain dict.
